supporting_sections: What The User Should Understand First

accepted: Every gathered artifact family needs a discoverable place, even when the body stays out of first-read UI.
The next UI slice should be a run inventory receipt rather than a bigger graph.
Conversation extraction needs a visible interpretation-status route from Outcome or Receipts.
Model pages should lead with readable meaning and expandable sections, not raw canonical Markdown dumps.
Local model neighborhoods should precede a full corpus graph.
Treatment audits, Gate 4 probes, schemas, non-V60 affordances, result/memo artifacts, run events, and graph survival artifacts must be accounted for.
deferred_or_rejected: Do not collapse show_by_default into primary_surface yet; first-glance copy and main-tab copy have different product jobs.
Do not collapse operator_inspection into technical_inspection yet; user-reachable audit details and maintainer-only raw machinery need different gates.
Do not rename Download MD in this slice; the short label should be explained with hover/help text.
Do not render raw embeddings, private ledgers, or provider-private bodies just because they exist; expose status/counts/receipts and safe routes instead.

strongest_useful_signal: The table reframes gathered run data as progressively inspectable: every gathered artifact should have a summary, expansion, technical route, explicit export, or redacted receipt, and the added Discovery Map says where the user finds each family.
strongest_unresolved_risk: The matrix is still a design decision artifact. It now strongly recommends a run inventory receipt panel, but the UI has not yet implemented the receipt, the clean model-page expansion, or the local model-neighborhood treatment.
recommended_next_pr: Add Observatory run inventory receipt panel
